served: nystagmus: direction and whether it changes with gaze
results: 1. nystagmus: direction and whether it changes with gaze: PENDULAR TORSIONAL nystagmus, isolated
2. paraneoplastic and autoimmune antibody panel (serum): ANTI-MA2 antibodies detected in BOTH serum and CSF, with the typical neuronal nucleolar staining pattern
3. CT chest / abdomen / pelvis (occult tumour): bulky perihilar mass in the left upper lung with vascular and mediastinal invasion and ipsilateral lymphadenopathy
4. lumbar puncture / CSF: CSF-restricted oligoclonal bands
5. medication and oncology history: anti-PD-L1 durvalumab; symptoms began suddenly after the seventh administration
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Anti-Ma2–associated paraneoplastic encephalitis with brainstem/cerebellar ocular-motor involvement, caused by an occult left lung carcinoma and precipitated or unmasked by durvalumab (anti-PD-L1 therapy).

Alternative 1: Durvalumab-associated autoimmune encephalitis without a paraneoplastic mechanism.

Alternative 2: Anti-Hu or anti-GABA-B receptor paraneoplastic encephalitis associated with small-cell lung carcinoma.

Alternative 3: Paraneoplastic brainstem/cerebellar syndrome from an occult lung malignancy with antibody-negative or non-Ma2 autoimmunity.
dx: Anti-Ma2–associated paraneoplastic encephalitis with brainstem/cerebellar ocular-motor involvement, caused by an occult left lung carcinoma and precipitated or unmasked by durvalumab (anti-PD-L1 therapy).
